graph.alt: Graph of wavelength against time, with 18 plotted points and error bars, and a dashed line showing the laboratory wavelength. The wavelength rises and falls regularly, above and below the laboratory wavelength, with about two and a half cycles over the observations; the points are unevenly spaced in time.
graph.caption: Graph of wavelength against time. The error bars show the uncertainties. The dashed line shows the laboratory wavelength.

graph-ms.alt: Graph of wavelength against time, with 18 plotted points and error bars, and the model curve (the orbit model used to simulate the observations), and a dashed line showing the laboratory wavelength. The wavelength rises and falls regularly, above and below the laboratory wavelength, with about two and a half cycles over the observations; the points are unevenly spaced in time.
graph-ms.caption: Graph of wavelength against time. Blue: the orbit model used to simulate the observations. The dashed line shows the laboratory wavelength.
